reviewAdvisory: The figures give only consumption values and growth rates; they do not state what drives data-center electricity growth, so the draft attributes a cause the evidence does not contain.
The figures contain no wear, replacement or expansion data, so this chain of consequences is invented rather than derived from the supplied numbers.

Nothing in the figures states that operators are ordering, that foreign suppliers have a window, or that domestic manufacturers will absorb demand; this is speculation presented as a sourcing conclusion.
The draft elsewhere admits the figures state no lead times, yet here asserts a competition for factory capacity that no supplied figure supports.
The figures contain no forecast or timing signal, so the two-to-three-quarter window is invented and the article's central sourcing advice rests on it.
The draft compares a single-month growth rate with a ten-month cumulative growth rate as if they were the same measure, which is a cross-level comparison the figures do not support.
